# colorSchemeScript

The script that sets the page's color scheme before it paints, so a reload in dark mode never flashes light. It reads the choice `ColorSchemeProvider` keeps in `localStorage`, resolves `system` through `prefers-color-scheme`, and sets the `.dark` class and the `color-scheme` property on `<html>`. Put it in `<head>` as an inline script, with the same options as the provider, and add `suppressHydrationWarning` to `<html>`, whose class the script changes before React hydrates. It is plain text, so a Server Component can call it.

```tsx
import { colorSchemeScript } from "@/registry/ouro/lib/ouro/color-scheme-script";
```

## Example

```tsx
<html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>
  <head>
    <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: colorSchemeScript() }} />
  </head>
  <body>
    <ColorSchemeProvider>{children}</ColorSchemeProvider>
  </body>
</html>
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `ColorSchemeOptions` | `{}` |

## Returns

`string`
